versions.changelog:
guaikei-douyin-raw-to-structured-pipeline v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides structured access to Douyin (TikTok China) public data: keyword search, creator posts, video comments, real-time trending topics.
- Supports up to 10,000 items per query with multi-dimensional filtering and bulk retrieval.
- Designed for content research, competitor monitoring, trend analysis, and public opinion tracking in Douyin scenarios only.
- Command-line based, outputs pure JSON for further analysis; requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for operation.
- No login or write operations required; only fetches public data, ensuring account safety.
